# openrouter_organization_members (Data Source)

OrganizationMembers DataSource

## Example Usage

## Schema

### Read-Only

- `data` (Attributes List) List of organization members (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `total_count` (Number) Total number of members in the organization

### Nested Schema for `data`
